title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Your makerspace assistant is about to make a model call. Which of these is part of what the model sees on that call?

options.text: Every earlier session this student has had with the assistant
The system prompt, tool definitions, and the messages so far
The calendar database behind check_calendar, in full
The model's own memory of its previous call in this run

items.stem: In one request, the system prompt and tool definitions total 800 tokens and the student's question is 100 tokens. The assistant makes three model calls. After call 1 and again after call 2, the program appends a tool request and result of 400 tokens, and nothing is ever removed. Counting only input tokens, how many tokens are sent across all three calls in total?
Your assistant must answer questions from a 40,000-token machine manual, and the sponsor's budget is small. Which design is best for cost and for accuracy?

options.text: Paste the whole manual into the system prompt so it is always present
Train the model on the manual so it needs no text in its window
Search the manual and put only the best few chunks in the window
Summarize the manual once and send that summary on every call

items.stem: A large tool result arrives early in a long agent run and is never removed. In one sentence, why does it cost more than the same result arriving at the very last step?
Your manual search returns the chunk "The minimum is 10%." and the model cannot tell which machine or setting it refers to. In one sentence, what is the problem with the chunk and one way to fix it?
